name: The Amazing Digital Dating Simulator
source:
The Amazing Digital Dating Simulator is a visual novel-style fan game for Glitch's popular hit show "The Amazing Digital Circus".

Taking place in the anime adventure world, spend 5 days helping the cast prepare for the upcoming culture festival. There are 5 romance-able characters: Pomni, Ragatha, Gangle, Zooble, and Jax!

[From [url=https://vocastar.itch.io/tadds-fangame]itch.io[/url]]
